headline: Nobody counts these as love yet
body:
He stops crying a half-second before you pick him up.
_He heard you coming._
He turns his head toward one voice in a room full of voices.

He falls asleep on you and not in the perfectly good bassinet you assembled twice.
He waits — fed, changed, nothing actually wrong — until you're the one who comes.
You keep asking whether he knows you yet.
*He's been answering in the only language he has, since the first week.*
